title: Player momentum (experimental, unwitnessed)
summary: Adjust fast turning and ordinary braking, with separate capped running-start and weight-and-velocity contact options.

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Opt in manually after protected build integration; all presets default off.

input_constraints: Pinned USA native resolver, accessor, pair calculation, reaction dispatcher, turn tables and hooks; complete sections and code seals validated.
Integer momentum and momentum_collision_level 0..100; Boolean momentum_contact and momentum_collisions. Run-up requires positive momentum; positive collision level requires its separate flag.
All presets off/0. Collisions can be enabled with movement momentum 0 and run-up off. Both levels 0 leave retail bytes identical.
Combined named requests chosen before installing any owner; collisions require allocator scale-out. Rebuild from the supported base to change settings or upgrade model 1.
Live ordinary attached ball carrier only; collision gain capped at six effective rating points, combined run-up/collision gain at eight. Legacy rating ramp must be off for parity witnesses.
portme: Wire the two new independent collision fields and component status into the protected dispatcher, BuildPlan and UI using WIRING.md.
Witness selected tackle/reaction animations, yards after contact, boot, lifecycle and both human and CPU play; a matched native fixture does not remove retail controller-side branches.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Bounded native contact resolver and reaction-dispatch branch selection, mass/speed/standing comparisons, ABI and matched-context CPU/human parity. Animation entry is a fixture boundary. Gameplay and loader remain unwitnessed.

fields.name: momentum_contact
fields.allowed: Boolean, default false; true requires momentum > 0

selectors.notes: Model 2 uses one owner. Collision-only mode leaves movement hooks/tables retail. Omitted replay settings retain configuration. In-place upgrades of model 1 refuse.

source_container.retail_file: user-owned default.xbe in an NFL 2K5 USA disc
source_container.resource: ordinary turn curve, pinned locomotion/contact hooks, named grown RX/RW allocations
